key_concepts: Momentum is expressed as p = mv
An object at rest has zero momentum because its velocity is zero
A moving object with mass has momentum
At the same speed, a more massive object has greater momentum
A change in velocity or mass causes a change in momentum
Impulse is equal to change in momentum
An object moving with constant momentum has zero impulse
Collisions involve impulses and momentum changes
In a collision, an object's impulse is equal to its momentum change
